subject.title: [Bug]: Default sandbox image openclaw-sandbox:bookworm-slim lacked python3, breaking edit/write

question: Should the live external closing PR be closed as superseded so this issue can be closed as implemented by v2026.4.27?
rationale: Current main and the shipped release fix the default-image root cause, but an open external PR still references this issue with closing syntax and needs maintainer disposition before automated issue cleanup is safe.

options.title: Close linked PR, then close issue
options.body: Treat the external PR as superseded by the shipped same-repository fix and close this issue as implemented after that PR is handled.

options.title: Keep for custom-image support
options.body: Keep this issue open only if maintainers want to make Python-less custom sandbox images a supported core behavior.

options.title: Adopt external PR
options.body: Review the external PR for any unique diagnostics before closing, but require proof that it adds value beyond the shipped default-image guard.

recommendation.title: Close linked PR, then close issue
recommendation.body: Treat the external PR as superseded by the shipped same-repository fix and close this issue as implemented after that PR is handled.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored and merged the shipped default-image fallback fix and is the best routed owner for deciding whether the remaining linked PR is superseded.
